text.tspan: Drag a gear so its rim touches another — they snap and mesh, spinning opposite ways.
Drop a gear onto another's centre to stack them on one axle (a compound gear), spinning together.
Here, the two grey gears are joined together as a compound gear, so they spin at the same
speed. The blue and yellow gears are the same size. But blue is connected to the bigger part
of the compound gear, so blue spins faster.
